usedFor: HubSpot holds the contacts and deals, and Bolna places the call with “Make a Phone Call” when lead status changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Update Contact's Lead Status” in HubSpot, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A contact's lead status change can prompt a phone call from Bolna while the change is fresh.

watchOut: “New Task Due” in HubSpot polls, so a Bolna call from it starts on a schedule, not when due.
